what: When the page opens, the ”Loading” text and an 80px bar (a curtain-colored light streak passes left→right over 1.4s) show at the center of the background-color curtain covering the screen. After .5s the text and bar slide up 130% and fade (.8s), and after .7s the curtain lifts up 100% (.8s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1)). At 1.4s the curtain is hidden and fx:done fires. A quiet loading that runs each time a page is freshly loaded.

options.--fx-dur: Length for the text/bar and curtain to clear (via style), default .8s
options.--fx-delay: Delay before text and bars start fading out, default .5s
options.--fx-veil-delay: Delay before the curtain starts lifting, default .7s
options.--fx-hide: When the veil starts to be hidden (visibility), default 1.2s (hidden .2s later)
options.--fx-bar-dur: Time for the light streak to pass once, default 1.4s
options.wait: With load, it starts only after the images have all arrived (default: right on attach)

note: The motion is a CSS transition, and js adds is-lifted to the next frame. With reduced motion, the loader is hidden. To set up the subpage header after the loader clears, use fx:done (about 1.4s) or, like the original, a 1s timer
